name: Rika
source:
Rika is a squirrel-girl who lives in the forest.

She is good at disguising herself thanks to the color of leaves in the forest. The color of the foliage is similar to the color of fur on her tail.

You have to sweat to persuade her as she hardly takes other person's point of view. She is quite stubborn.

One of her ancestors was a human.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1933372300/forest-fortress-live2d-animated-novel]Kickstarter campaign[/url]]
